summary.en: Personal portfolio currently represented by design explorations rather than a production-ready site.
summary.pl: Portfolio osobiste istniejące obecnie jako eksploracje designu, nie gotowa strona produkcyjna.

estimation.sourceState: Clean source reviewed October 3; integrated Portfolio.html selected over auxiliary prototypes. No production application implementation performed by coordinator.

current.en: Gemini may start: Inventory corrective review accepted October 7. Port the existing Portfolio.html design into Vite/React.
current.pl: Gemini może zacząć: przegląd poprawek Inventory przyjęty 7 października. Przenieść obecny Portfolio.html do Vite/React.

next.en: Local compiled assets, browser/accessibility tests, qualified Pages artifact preview and protected production.
next.pl: Lokalne skompilowane assety, browser/accessibility i kwalifikowany artefakt Pages z chronioną produkcją.

title.en: Build the portfolio from existing prototypes

tasks.evidence: October 3 clean source contains integrated Portfolio.html and reference explorations. Port existing PL/EN/themes/filters/hash details to Vite/React with local locked dependencies; remove runtime Babel/CDN development React/debug UI. Preserve design; no backend/Coolify.

title.en: Add build, accessibility and browser tests
title.pl: Dodać testy buildu, dostępności i przeglądarki

tasks.evidence: No package/build/tests at reviewed source. Add reproducible build and real browser checks for keyboard/mobile/reduced-motion/language/themes/filter/deep-link/unknown-route behavior before release.

title.en: Add Quality, a ruleset and Pages environment
title.pl: Dodać Quality, ruleset i environment Pages

tasks.evidence: Add PR Quality, protected main and protected production for trusted artifact promotion; coordinator reviews governance settings. Current source has no production workflow.

title.en: Add README, MIT and content maintenance docs
title.pl: Dodać README, MIT i utrzymanie treści

tasks.evidence: No maintained production README/license/content process in reviewed source. Verify asset/third-party licenses and operator biography/CV links; document build/deploy/rollback without invented content.

title.en: Deploy Cloudflare Pages preview and production
title.pl: Wdrożyć preview i produkcję Cloudflare Pages

tasks.evidence: Prepare Pages Direct Upload CI: one tested artifact with source SHA/checksum to preview and protected production. October 3 project-metadata read failed authentication, so current Pages project state is unknown, not absent.

Historical August 25 HTTP 525 remains dated history. October 3 selected DNS readback does not establish a working Pages site. Coordinate domain binding/TLS/rollback and preserve existing mail records; no VPS ingress change.
Prepare public availability and deployment failure visibility; prove agreed notification rather than claim monitored production from a successful build.

title.en: Add favicon, metadata and project previews
title.pl: Dodać favicon, metadata i podglądy projektów

tasks.evidence: No accepted final favicon/metadata/canonical/social preview. Keep existing design, verify fonts/credits/content, safe unknown route and public project references.

verification.worktree: Clean 2b3e093 reviewed October 3; integrated Portfolio.html is the selected base.
verification.tests: No reproducible package/build/tests yet; existing design behavior is not browser/accessibility acceptance.
verification.ci: No implementation or deploy pipeline was introduced in this coordination task. Qualified static artifact Quality/preview/production is the assigned next work.
verification.production: Pages project metadata remains unknown after October 3 authentication failure. No new portfolio deployment accepted; August 25 HTTP 525 is historical evidence.

decisions.en: Build as a static site; application rate limiting is unnecessary until dynamic endpoints exist.
decisions.pl: Budować statycznie; limiter aplikacyjny jest zbędny do czasu dynamicznych endpointów.

decisions.en: The roadmap site remains a separate repository and data source.
decisions.pl: Strona roadmapy pozostaje osobnym repozytorium i źródłem danych.

decisions.en: The project follows the v2 standard profile: static-web.
decisions.pl: Projekt podlega profilowi standardu v2: static-web.

decisions.en: Gemini after Inventory review; start from Portfolio.html, preserve design and use Vite/React static output. Coordinator owns status/platform changes; Pages CI has minimal account Pages permissions, not DNS/R2/Tunnel permissions.
decisions.pl: Gemini po przeglądzie Inventory; Portfolio.html, zachowanie designu i static Vite/React. Koordynator prowadzi status/platformę; CI Pages ma minimalne uprawnienia Pages konta, bez DNS/R2/Tunnel.

notes.en: Next bounded Gemini task is static portfolio engineering, preserving the current design. Use Vite/React, compile JSX, locked local assets and real responsive/browser tests. Read-only Cloudflare access cannot currently enumerate Pages; operator configuration follows a concrete candidate. No backend, application limiter or Coolify deployment is planned. Inventory corrective review was accepted October 7; Gemini may begin. Portfolio source/Pages evidence remains dated October 3; no new implementation is claimed. Delivery timing depends on candidate and operator availability.
notes.pl: Następne ograniczone zadanie Gemini to engineering statycznego portfolio z zachowaniem designu. Vite/React, kompilacja JSX, lokalne assety/lock i rzeczywiste testy responsive/browser. Odczyt Pages jest obecnie niedostępny; operator konfiguruje po przygotowaniu kandydata. Nie planujemy backendu, limitera aplikacyjnego ani Coolify. Przegląd poprawek Inventory przyjęto 7 października; Gemini może zacząć. Dowody źródeł/Pages pozostają z 3 października; nie deklarujemy nowej implementacji. Termin wdrożenia zależy od kandydata i operatora.
